subject: E-3381: totals mismatch on Linux
body:
Hello support team. We run MeshMail 2.8.7 on Fedora 41. Whenever I export the report since Monday, the app shows "E-3381: totals do not match source".

Each line is off by a few cents, clearly a rounding issue. The latest changelog talks about a fix for rounding.

What I tried so far: searching the help centre. No luck.

Regards, Sofia Rossi, Caldera Foods
